categories.name: 技术
categories.hint: AI and the craft of software and hardware, which are one section here: models, agents, how they are built, what they can and cannot do, their effect on work; and systems, debugging, security, privacy, open source, protocols, the web platform, chips and how they are made. A war story about a database bug and a piece about what an agent can actually do both belong here. A piece that merely uses an AI tool to do something else belongs in the category of that something else. The physics or biology behind a technology is 'science'; how a tool feels to use is 'design'; a company's strategy around a technology is 'business'.

categories.name: 商业
categories.hint: Companies, strategy, markets, product decisions, platform policy, regulation of an industry. The subject is how an organisation behaves, not how a technology works. A whole economy or a government's policy is 'economy', not here.

categories.name: 投资
categories.hint: Capital and markets as the subject: asset prices, valuation, portfolio reasoning, financial theory and its failures, macro as it bears on returns. A company story is only here if it is argued from the investor's side. Labour markets, trade and public spending are 'economy'.

categories.name: 经济
categories.hint: Economics and public policy as the subject: macro, labour and jobs, immigration, trade, housing and cities, healthcare, energy, taxes, elections and how a government actually governs. The argument is about how a society allocates or rules, at the scale of a country or a city. Aimed at an investor's returns it is 'investing'; about a single company it is 'business'.

categories.name: 科学
categories.hint: Findings and methods from the natural and social sciences, read for what they show about the world: medicine, health, psychology, biology, physics, space, materials, statistics, whether a study replicates. A paper about labour markets is 'economy'; a chip fabrication process is 'tech'.

categories.name: 设计
categories.hint: Design, craft and creative work: interface and UX, typography, visual and product design, architecture as aesthetics, art, writing and the writer's process, taste and how a thing is made well. The subject is the making, not the market it sells into.

categories.name: 生活
categories.hint: How one person actually works and lives: attention, habits, tools and routines, calendars and meetings, careers, burnout, money at household scale, relationships, health as daily practice. Usually first-person and prescriptive. A study about what makes people happy is 'science'; a critique of society at large is the catch-all.

categories.name: 人文
categories.hint: LAST RESORT — use only when none of the categories above fits. History, philosophy, religion, language, media and internet culture, obituaries, how a society thinks about itself. An essay is not filed here just because it is reflective: reflective about models is still 'tech', about jobs still 'economy', about one's own working habits still 'living', about a study still 'science'.

sources.name: Heavybit Library
sources.description: 开发者工具公司的工程与增长访谈，近期几乎全是 AI agent 基础设施话题。

sources.name: Hacker News
sources.description: Hacker News 头条聚合，内容取决于当天社区，质量与主题都不可控；已限 maxPerRun 5。

sources.name: Platformer
sources.description: Casey Newton 的科技平台报道，聚焦 AI 公司动向与内部访谈。

sources.name: Astral Codex Ten
sources.description: Scott Alexander，理性主义长文与书评，但 Open Thread 这类纯站务帖占了不小比例。

sources.name: Construction Physics
sources.description: 建造业与住房供给政策分析，间杂「Reading List」链接汇总。

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.description: Nielsen Norman Group 的 UX 研究，近期大量 AI 与设计流程话题，偶有课程广告。

sources.name: Benedict Evans
sources.description: 科技行业结构性分析，AI 商业模式与市场格局，更新慢但每篇有观点。

sources.name: WESTENBERG
sources.description: 哲学化的生产力与生活方式随笔，标题风格强烈，论证密度参差。

sources.name: ByteCode.News
sources.description: 个人向科技随笔，兼有工具发布公告。

sources.name: Jake Gold
sources.description: Jake Gold，安全、网络与 AI 行业短评。

sources.name: Uncharted Territories
sources.description: Tomas Pueyo，地缘政治、能源与 AI 的宏观分析，含定期的 Dispatch 汇总栏目。

sources.name: the singularity is nearer
sources.description: George Hotz，对 AI 泡沫与行业炒作的尖锐短评。

sources.name: Not Boring
sources.description: Packy McCormick，创业公司深度与乐观主义叙事；「Weekly Dose of Optimism」是链接汇总。

sources.name: Lenny's Newsletter
sources.description: 产品管理与增长，访谈和播客转录占多数，夹带自家招聘与产品公告。

sources.name: Noahpinion
sources.description: Noah Smith，宏观经济与产业政策，间有旅行和美食这类私人话题。

sources.name: 阮一峰的网络日志
sources.description: 科技爱好者周刊，每周一期的链接与工具汇总，中文。

sources.name: Of Dollars And Data
sources.description: Nick Maggiulli，用数据讲个人理财与长期投资心态。

sources.name: Musings on Markets
sources.description: Aswath Damodaran，估值方法与个股拆解，专业度最高的一个投资源。

sources.name: Interconnects
sources.description: Nathan Lambert，大模型后训练与开源模型进展的技术分析。

sources.name: Import AI
sources.description: Jack Clark 的 AI 周报，逐条点评论文与行业动态，篇幅长。

sources.name: One Useful Thing
sources.description: Ethan Mollick，AI 的实际使用方式与对工作的影响，面向非专家。

sources.name: The Intrinsic Perspective
sources.description: Erik Hoel，意识研究、神经科学与学术圈批评。

sources.name: Cal Newport
sources.description: Cal Newport，深度工作、注意力与 AI 对脑力劳动的影响。

sources.name: Conversable Economist
sources.description: Timothy Taylor，经济学论文与史料的通俗解读，学术味重。

sources.name: Dan Luu
sources.description: Dan Luu，实证导向的系统与工程分析，长文，一年只有几篇。

sources.name: Craig Mod
sources.description: Craig Mod，日本、徒步、摄影与出版的随笔；含 RODEN/RIDGELINE 等多个栏目。

sources.name: Works in Progress
sources.description: 进步研究，医学、农业、城市的长篇实证文章，质量稳定。

sources.name: 404 Media
sources.description: 记者自营的科技调查报道，监控、平台滥用、AI 乱象；已限 maxPerRun 3。

sources.name: Where’s Your Ed At
sources.description: Ed Zitron，对 AI 商业模式的尖锐批判，长文，立场极强。

sources.name: Blood in the Machine
sources.description: Brian Merchant，技术批评与劳工视角，反 AI 立场鲜明。

sources.name: Citation Needed
sources.description: Molly White，加密货币与科技行业问责；「Issue NNN」是周期性链接汇总。

sources.name: The Markup
sources.description: 算法问责调查报道，隐私、医疗数据、平台监管。

sources.name: Rest of World
sources.description: 非西方视角的科技商业报道，中国出海、新兴市场，选题独特。

sources.name: Pluralistic
sources.description: Cory Doctorow，版权、反垄断与平台批判，日更且每篇含大段链接汇总。

sources.name: Simon Willison
sources.description: LLM 工程一线实践，模型评测与工具发布，更新频繁且信息密度高。

sources.name: Marc Brooker
sources.description: AWS 首席工程师，分布式系统与数据库，篇篇有原创观点。

sources.name: 宝玉的分享
sources.description: 宝玉，AI 工程实践与行业观察，中文，也发翻译。

sources.name: ACOUP
sources.description: Bret Devereaux，古代军事与社会史的长篇连载，学术但可读性强。

sources.name: Quanta Magazine
sources.description: 数学与基础科学报道，专业记者撰写，是 science 分类的主力；已限 maxPerRun 3。

sources.name: Bits about Money
sources.description: Patrick McKenzie，支付与银行系统内幕，更新慢但每篇都是长文。

sources.name: Apricitas Economics
sources.description: 图表驱动的宏观经济分析，电力、关税、产业政策。

sources.name: Escaping Flatland
sources.description: Henrik Karlsson，关于思考方式、育儿与社群的个人随笔。

sources.name: The Convivial Society
sources.description: L.M. Sacasas，技术哲学，追问技术如何改变人的处境。

sources.name: Res Obscura
sources.description: Benjamin Breen，历史学者写的科技史与文化史随笔。

sources.name: RogerEbert.com
sources.description: 影评站，含影展报道与讣告；产出中影展片单、游戏评测这类小众条目占比高。

sources.name: Nautilus
sources.description: 科普长文，衰老、神经、演化，面向大众；已限 maxPerRun 3。

sources.name: Psyche
sources.description: Aeon 旗下，心理学与生活实践的短文，teaser feed 需抓正文；已限 maxPerRun 3。

sources.name: Design Observer
sources.description: 设计评论，谈职业、协作与设计伦理，不是前端技术。

sources.name: Net Interest
sources.description: Marc Rubinstein，金融业与金融股的深度分析。

sources.name: Klement on Investing
sources.description: Joachim Klement，用学术研究讲投资与宏观，每篇很短；已限 maxPerRun 2。

sources.name: 硅谷居士
sources.description: 硅谷居士，中文的指数投资与 FIRE，文学城博客，靠 scrape 抓取；已限 maxPerRun 3。

sources.name: Early Retirement Now
sources.description: SWR 安全提取率的量化研究系列，FIRE 领域最硬的一个，长文。

sources.name: JL Collins
sources.description: 《The Simple Path to Wealth》作者，指数投资入门，更新很少。

sources.name: The Conversation
sources.description: 学者本人写的解释性长文，Atom 带全文 ~7.8k；6.8 篇/天且选题从疫苗到中世纪史横跨极大，靠 maxPerRun 2 压量。

sources.name: JSTOR Daily
sources.description: 把 JSTOR 上的论文改写成通俗文章，全文 ~9.2k，史料与社科向；~0.8 篇/天，偶尔只是论文导读。

sources.name: Noema Magazine
sources.description: Berggruen 研究院的杂志，技术哲学与地缘政治，全文 17k~38k；作者多为学者，行文偏抽象。

sources.name: The Paris Review Daily
sources.description: 《巴黎评论》的日更博客，文学随笔与作家访谈，全文 ~12.7k；纯文学向，和现有源零重叠。

sources.name: The Honest Broker
sources.description: Ted Gioia，音乐与文化批评，全文 ~4k；~0.38 篇/天，偶尔是唱片推荐清单体。

sources.name: After Babel
sources.description: Jonathan Haidt 的合著博客，手机、社交媒体与青少年心理，全文 ~15k；立场鲜明，数据解读常被同行质疑。

sources.name: Dynomight
sources.description: 匿名作者的量化随笔，用数据认真回答无聊问题，全文 ~9.7k；~13 天一篇，成本可忽略。

sources.name: Experimental History
sources.description: Adam Mastroianni，心理学与学术体制的批判性随笔，全文 ~16k；风格夸张，论证有时靠比喻推进。

sources.name: Ground Truths
sources.description: Eric Topol，医学研究、衰老与医疗 AI，0.12 篇/天，feed 带全文 3k~13.7k；约一半条目是访谈实录而非文章，正文里混着 Substack 的推广尾巴。

sources.name: Your Local Epidemiologist
sources.description: Katelyn Jetelina，流行病学家写的公共卫生实操（山火烟怎么防、疫苗打不打、季节性疫情），0.36 篇/天，全文 ~8.4k 且全部免费；每周有一条是疫情数字流水账，属于 substance 3-4 的选摘体。

sources.name: The Atlantic · Health
sources.description: The Atlantic 健康栏目，0.5 篇/天，feed 给整篇正文（~8.2k，实测结尾自然，不是预览）；栏目边界很宽，会混进与身体健康无关的生活报道。

sources.name: Renaissance Periodization
sources.description: 教练团队写的训练与营养实操（肌酸、体脂秤准不准、增肌减脂怎么排），0.12 篇/天，Atom 带全文 5k~12k；约四分之一条目是自家 app 的更新软文，靠分数门槛滤。

sources.name: Dwarkesh Podcast
sources.description: Dwarkesh Patel 的长访谈，对象以 AI 研究者和经济史学者为主，0.18 篇/天；Substack 每期带完整对谈文字稿，中位 22.6k、最长 143k，偶有几百字符的预告条目。

sources.name: ChinaTalk
sources.description: Jordan Schneider，中国科技与产业政策，编辑过的访谈文字稿加分析，中位 32.8k；0.69 篇/天且正文极长，已限 maxPerRun 2，选题从出口管制横跨到东南亚见闻和朝鲜史。

sources.name: Powderworks
sources.description: 匿名作者的 Substack，写用 coding agent 做大型项目踩出来的教训和为此自制的工具，兼谈软件生产到底是手艺还是工业过程；feed 带全文，实测 2.2k 与 72.9k，都免费。全站只有 2 篇（2026-08-08 / 08-12），频率无法实测，最新一篇距今 14 天 —— 一个还没证明会持续更新的新号。
